import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]

positions = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
for i, value in enumerate(data[1:]):
    positions[value].append(i)

values = [v for v in range(1, n + 1) if positions[v]]
answer = 1

for i, a in enumerate(values):
    for b in values[i + 1:]:
        pa = positions[a]
        pb = positions[b]
        ia = ib = 0
        runs = 0
        last = 0

        while ia < len(pa) or ib < len(pb):
            if ib == len(pb) or (ia < len(pa) and pa[ia] < pb[ib]):
                current = a
                ia += 1
            else:
                current = b
                ib += 1

            if current != last:
                runs += 1
                last = current

        answer = max(answer, runs)

print(answer)
